attribution: Building geometry and register attributes: City of Helsinki, CC BY 4.0. Material analysis: Helsinki Rides project.
scope: Census covers all 304 cells and 1,695 building records. The named inventory below contains 134 records with a municipal VTJ identifier; another 59 constant-wall source records lack that identifier. Source-matched wall faces have constant UV coordinates or no image map. Distant vertex-colour LOD is deliberately excluded.
limitations: A constant-colour source wall is a reconstruction candidate, not proof that real architecture should have openings.
Party walls, buried foundations, plinths and genuinely blank elevations require separate reference qualification.
Records may be partially restored already. Only individually referenced elevations may receive new artwork.
This is the frozen before inventory; per-elevation plans and ledgers identify subsequent repairs.
